title: 基本句型（二）：想要、需要、喜欢、会
en: Basic Sentences (2): want, need, like, can
goal: 用最常用的动词表达需求和喜好：I want / I need / I like / I can，听懂 Do you ...? / Can you ...? 并回答。
tips: want 很直接；对不熟的人更礼貌的说法是 I'd like ...（I would like）。
否定和提问要加 do：I don't like ... / Do you like ...? 回答 Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
can 后面直接跟动词：I can swim. / Can you help me? / I can't come.

exchanges.hear: What do you want to eat?

exchanges.reply: Yes, please. I can't open this door.
exchanges.replyZh: 需要，谢谢。这个门我打不开。

exchanges.reply: A little. I can understand slow English.
exchanges.replyZh: 会一点。说慢一点我能听懂。

exchanges.reply: No, I don't. I take the subway.

exchanges.hear: Do you know where the station is?

exchanges.reply: Sorry, I can't. I have to work.

lines.en: Come in! Would you like some tea or coffee?
Tea, please. I don't drink coffee.
Sure. Do you like green tea?
Yes, I like it very much.
Are you hungry? I have some cake.
By the way, can you help me with something?
Of course. What do you need?
I need to write an email in Chinese. Can you check it?
lines.zh: 我要写一封中文邮件，你能帮我看看吗？
